opening: I get palpitations; my heart races or beats irregularly.
My symptoms get worse when I lie down and better when I sit up.
The pain gets worse when I breathe in deeply.
I'm quite short of breath; it's hard to breathe.
I've had a viral infection recently.

opening.text: I'm here because I've been having pain that gets worse when I breathe in deeply. I'm also getting palpitations where my heart races or beats irregularly, and I'm quite short of breath. It seems to get worse when I lie down and better when I sit up. I've had a viral infection recently.
